🌍 President: Iran will not bow to excessive demands at negotiating table

📌 Tehran, IRNA - President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iran’s ongoing negotiations are being conducted with full dignity and authority within the framework set by the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, vowing that the country will not yield to any attempt to disregard the Iranian nation’s rights.

Speaking at a ceremony marking National Guilds Day on Monday, June 22, 2026, President Pezeshkian opened his remarks by honoring the martyrs of the recent war, in particular the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, and extended condolences on the arrival of the month of Muharram.
​
He also emphasized the strategic role played by guilds and trade unions in preserving national stability and maintaining services to the people throughout the recent imposed war by the US and the Israeli regime.
​
Turning to the diplomatic front, the president referenced the government’s efforts to consolidate the gains achieved by Iran’s Armed Forces and people.
​
“The negotiations that are underway are being pursued with dignity and authority, within the framework determined by the Leader of the Islamic Revolution,” he said.
​
“Wherever they seek to disregard the rights of the Iranian nation, we will not back down under any circumstances, and we will not bow to excessive demands,” he added.
​
On the question of Lebanon, Pezeshkian described the enemy’s retreat as a significant achievement.
​
“The fact that today, as a result of the steadfastness and resistance of the negotiating team, the opposing side has been compelled to retreat on the issue of Lebanon and has ceased the killing and massacre of the oppressed people of that country, this is no small achievement,” he said.
​
He stressed that Iranians of all walks of life are partners in this success: “In this great achievement, all the people and all segments of society have had a share, whether the guilds and economic actors, or the fighters who were present on the battlefield with selfless sacrifice and gave their lives for the dignity and honor of the country.”
​
Addressing economic conditions, the president struck an optimistic tone.
​
“Fortunately, good openings have been achieved, the necessary foundations for economic prosperity have been laid, and the path for trade, investment, and guild activities has been made more available than before,” he said.
​
He added that Iran is also working to strengthen regional ties: “In the area of regional interactions, we are also striving to further strengthen relations and cooperation.”
​
He described Iran’s elevated international profile as a product of unity: “Today, Iran is at the top of world news, and Iran and Iranians are spoken of with dignity and respect and this achievement is nothing other than the result of unity and solidarity.”
​
The ceremony also included recognition of families of guild martyrs and trade union members, as well as leading figures from the guild sector, who received commemorative plaques and trophies. 4573**4353

Crypto Idea

🤖 Machines will learn to pay in crypto

Tether — the company behind USDT, the most widely used dollar-backed stablecoin in crypto — has invested $1.4 billion in German startup NEURA Robotics.

The goal: integrate crypto wallets into their robots.

A robot completes a task in a warehouse — it gets paid. It needs access to a service or data — it buys it itself.

A part breaks down — it orders a replacement on its own. The robot becomes more than just a machine; it becomes a full-fledged economic agent.

📍 Why crypto?

Opening a bank account for a robot isn't possible. But a stablecoin works around the clock, in any country, and for transactions of any size — without the bureaucracy.

That's exactly why Tether is moving into this space: if millions of autonomous robots are operating around the world by 2030, they'll need their own financial infrastructure. And Tether wants to be the first to build it.

⏺ They use programmable logic to execute rules like auto-payments or limit orders.

1️⃣ Automation — wallets can send recurring payments or rebalance portfolios automatically.
2️⃣ Recovery — no more lost seed phrases; users can restore access via social or multi-signature systems.
3️⃣ Security — built-in permissions reduce human error and scams.
4️⃣ Adoption — MetaMask Snaps and Argent are leading the innovation.
5️⃣ Future Outlook — expect smart wallets to replace traditional ones as default Web3 tools.
